The '''Ralltiir Exchange''' was a [[stock market]] based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]]. Reeling from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Subjugation of Ralltiir|crackdown]] on the planet, the Exchange suffered a collapse following the nationalization of [[Bansche Tech/Legends|Bansche Tech]], [[SGI Systems, Inc.]], [[Reiber Manufacturing]], and [[Sencil Corporation]].
